heroHeadline: Record 2026 Wildfire Season Scorches Over 4 Million Hectares Across Canada
heroSubtitle: 4,082,237 hectares burned across 4,654 fires as of 12 August; 5 dead, 36+ injured, 24,000+ evacuated including all 12,000 residents of Summerland, BC. Smoke has pushed AQI to record highs across 16+ US states, with Milwaukee hitting an all-time-record 644 on 16 July and Toronto recording the world's worst air quality on 15 July. Thunder Bay 36 is now the largest wildfire in Ontario history at ~320,000 hectares.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
